notes.title: Small Patch 0.3.1 - Minor bug and balance fixes
notes.notes:
Balance

 Enemies in Trial 2 increased movement speed from 6.1 to 8. This trial was trivialized with the players 20% increased movement speed in patch 0.3. The new change makes this trial more challenging again.



Bugfixes

 Repositioned the start timer for trial 5 specific runs. It was previously located at the entrance of the room while the player spawned inside the room, allowing the player to skip the timer completely. The timer now starts when the player enters the first platform.
 The end of run display text were incorrectly reading previous best times and deaths, making 'personal best' always being shown for these metrics. This has been fixed and 'personal best' should now only be shown for all time best scores of the current difficulty and trial selected.


UI

 Certain UI elements lacked auto sizing of text, which could create issues with certain language translations. Auto sizing have now been applied to these.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 – Demo Launch, Controller Support & Achievements
notes.notes:
🎮 Demo Released on Steam

 The demo build has been tested and approved by Steam.
 ➤ Play the first 5 Trials for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570330


🏆 Achievements Ready for Full Launch

 16 unique achievement icons have been created and implemented into the game.
 Achievements have been fully tested on Steam.
 Steam does not allow achievements in demos — they will go live with the full release.


🖼️ AI Art Replaced

 All temporary AI-generated art has been replaced.
 This includes menu backgrounds, achievement icons, and hallway paintings.


🎮 Partial Controller Support Added

 Controller hotkeys are now supported (joysticks tied to movement by default).
 Joysticks can be used to move the character freely.
 Button mapping varies by controller type — players can remap inputs for actions like jumping, menu selection, and camera rotation.
A new optional movement mode is available (press V) that locks camera to player rotation — useful 
Full controller support will require:
○ Xbox / PlayStation controller testing (still in progress).
○ A virtual keyboard setup for saving names to leaderboards with a controller.for some controller setups.


📺 YouTube Channel Launched

 Channel created: https://www.youtube.com/@SwabbieGames
 Trailer uploaded!
 A 6-minute video sharing the first year of development is now live.
 Shorts and update clips will be posted regularly.


🛠 Other Improvements

 Full Game Steam store page has been completed.
 Menu navigation now supports back/forward hotkeys, controller input, and custom keybindings.
 (ESC, ENTER, and SPACE still work too.)


🐛 Bug Fixes

 Ramp wall climbing removed:
○ Characters could previously wedge into ramp corners and climb walls slowly.
○ Wall friction has been reduced — this no longer seems possible.
 Wall clipping when climbing ramps fixed:
○ Hugging angled walls while moving up ramps could clip the character into geometry.
○ Cause: Walls were separated per floor.
○ Fix: An invisible wall object now stretches across floors, preventing clipping.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0 & 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Demo improvements
I've been hard at work improving the 9 Trials of Whiskers demo and setting up the foundation for an awesome speedrunning experience. Here’s what’s been added so far:

🔥 Leaderboards & Ghosts (Now Live in Demo!)

 Leaderboards and ghosts now dynamically save and load based on the active game version.
 This system also prepares for future Trial Mode options in the full game!

New Trial Selection Feature
🏆 New Individual Trial Mode (0.1.1 Update)

 You can now play any individual Trial instead of running all 9 at once!
 Think you have the fastest start in Trial 1? Prove it!
 Want to master a tough section like Trial 8? Now you can practice it!

🔹 Trial Options Available Now:

 Full game (9 Trials of Whiskers)
 Demo version (First 5 Trials)
 Any individual Trial (1-9)
 Each mode has its own separate leaderboards & ghosts, making it easy to track your best times.

Others
🎮 New Debug Mode for Faster Testing

 A debug mode has been added to speed up development & testing.
 Debug mode allows flying and disables collision, making it easier to test new features.


---------------------------------------------------------------------

Upcoming content
By the end of April 2025 I aim to complete the following:
🚀 Demo Release, Steam Wishlist & Marketing

 The demo will be released as soon as possible.

 The demo build will be submitted for approval soon, which typically takes 3-5 days.
 Once approved, the earliest possible release date will be 14 days after approval, as required by Steam. Trailers, gameplay videos, and social media content (YouTube, TikTok, Twitter, etc.) will follow to drive wishlists and community growth.
 Consistent short-form content (clips, dev logs, challenges) will be posted to create further growth.
🐞 Post-Demo Updates & Bug Fixes

 If many people play the demo, I expect new bugs and feature requests to emerge.
 I will allocate time to fix and improve the game based on feedback.

🎮 Controller support

 I’ll be testing full controller support once I get a controller, ensuring a smooth experience for all players.

🖥 System requirements testing

 I will explore virtual machines and performance benchmarks to determine recommended and minimum system requirements for 9 Trials of Whiskers.

🏅 Achievements for Steam

 Built in achievements in the game will be linked with Steam achievements.
